# BootstrapResponse

`schemas/api/bootstrap-response.json`

The response to POST /v1/bootstrap, a union on disposition: applied (the first operator and its first token exist) or refused (nothing was applied; a wrong, expired or consumed secret is failed/confirmation_refused).

A document is one of: [BootstrapApplied](#bootstrapapplied) or [BootstrapRefused](#bootstraprefused).

## Definitions

### BootstrapApplied

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `disposition` | yes | `applied` |  |
| `command` | yes | [CommandID](common-defs.md#commandid) |  |
| `replayed` | yes | boolean |  |
| `operator` | yes | [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) |  |
| `token` | yes | [TokenID](common-defs.md#tokenid) |  |
| `issued_credential` |  | string (pattern `^tok_[0-7][0-9a-hjkmnp-tv-z]{25}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{42}[AEIMQUYcgkosw048]$`) | The first token's bearer string, tok_&lt;id&gt;.&lt;secret&gt; (14 N3): present only on the response that applied the bootstrap, absent on a replay. It is never stored; a lost one is recovered offline (adcd recover operator-token). |

No other fields are allowed.
